name: Morning update
task: Get the weather for our three offices and the open issue count, then post a morning update to #general.
blurb: Four lookups start together. The post can't be undone, so it waits for them, and the plan shows it before anything runs.

name: Fan out
task: Which of these five cities is warmest right now?
blurb: Five lookups that don't need each other, all started at once.

name: Summarize hits
task: Search for "parallel tool calls" and give me a short note on each hit.
blurb: Each call waits only for the values it needs.

name: Triage and post
task: Count our open issues by label and post a summary to #weave-triage.
blurb: Two reads together, then one post that can't be undone.

name: Writes in order
task: Bump the visit counter, read it back, and email ops the new count.
blurb: Writes keep your order. Reads of other keys don't wait on them.

name: Broken script
task: Same kind of job, but the model made mistakes: a misspelled tool, a wrong argument, a key that isn't there.
blurb: The check catches all of it before anything runs, so nothing gets half done.

name: Catch an error
task: Get the temperature in three cities, even if one lookup fails.
blurb: A failed call is an exception you can catch, so one bad city doesn't sink the rest.
